content: F1 (severed feedback loop): record_yield.py and ingest_token_usage.py were the only writers to protocol_yield and discussion token totals. compute_agent_effectiveness still reads protocol_yield so findings_false_positive is permanently 0; v_token_efficiency view is permanently empty. briefings table has no outcome column, so ADR-0029's own stated falsification plan (compare deferrals against later trouble) cannot run. /retro retains a deletion prior with no measurement counterweight. F2 (third over-deletion): audit_calibration.py self-described as writing proposals to a human-approved queue and never editing a classifier surface - governance by ADR-0029's own test - yet was deleted as scaffolding; suggests sorting was by directory/line-count, not per-file. Also six ADRs (0013,0020,0022,0023,0024,0028) remain status:accepted with implementations deleted, and ADR-0029 supersedes is empty - a direct Principle 4 violation. F3: delete-and-see is valid for prose (symmetric cost, git recovery) but not for instrumented state (time series cannot be recovered retroactively); the two asset classes were priced identically.

BLOCKING: (1) /decide.md template emits id/Alternatives and omits decision_makers, but quality_gate requires adr_id/decision_makers/'## Alternatives Considered' - the primary governance workflow has no path to completion. (2) scripts/distribute/ (2470 lines + 1651 test lines) orphaned when /distribute deleted; /apply-framework rewritten in prose, moving safety invariants (clean-tree, overwrite floor, never-modify-settings) from deterministic code into prose - contradicts FRAMEWORK.md's own 'a prose guarantee is a request'. scripts/lineage/ (967+1314) likewise orphaned. (3) Nine ADRs status:accepted with deleted implementations; ADR-0029 supersedes empty. (4) settings.json patch unapplied - must be applied BEFORE merge, not after. (5) docs/CAPTURE_PIPELINE.md is a CLAUDE.md pointer and describes v3. (6) close_discussion.py:115 dangling advice. NON-BLOCKING: dead schema (5 tables zero readers/writers), quality_gate advisories for deleted subsystems, scripts/ excluded from format/lint/coverage while gate counts it as reviewable code, orphaned backup_utils/ingest_reflection/spawn_project, v3 docs 3300+ lines left in place, pyproject version still 3.5.0. Core assessed sound: capture chain single-entry/single-exit, assess_risk/briefing minimal and single-purpose, no premature layering.

HIGH: /apply-framework rewrite orphans every mechanical guard on the cross-repo trust boundary. wrap_data_only (prompt-injection framing on files read from a TARGET repo), redact_secrets (fail-closed scrubber on target diff text), apply_assent_preflight/update_consent (fail-closed Prime Objective per-instance assent), check_clean_tree - all now uncalled while the agent holds Write+Bash on two repos and is about to branch and copy files. Fail-closed security code with no caller reads as protection that is not there. Also: apply-framework.md:32 says copy .claude/ while :52 says never modify target settings.json - self-contradictory. MEDIUM: .claude/hooks/ is NOT in PROTECTED_PATTERNS while settings.json (which IS protected) references five now-missing hook files. Writing .claude/hooks/context-guard.sh - a plausible 'restore the missing hook' action and exactly what an injection would request - yields arbitrary execution on every UserPromptSubmit without touching a protected file. Previously those files existed and were tracked, so subversion showed as modification; now it is an innocuous new file. Missing bash hook exits 127 (fails open); missing python stop_hook exits 2 = block-stoppage + inject stderr every turn. LOW-MED: _is_retired converts 'delete the source' into a way to silence a guard, introduced and used in the same commit. Ledger test_file column rewritten to tests/test_init_db.py names three test functions that do not exist there - false linkage in an audit record. CLEAN: validate_tool_use rewrite verified equivalent by import across 24 adversarial paths - 12 SECRET_PATTERNS, PROTECTED_PATTERNS, TEST_FILE_PATTERNS identical; removed locking was concurrency not security. notify/ask_developer/collab_loop topic slug does not leak on any error path.
